SystemTable.name: recycle_bin
SystemTable.Create: create table if not exists `recycle_bin` ( `id` bigint unsigned not null auto_increment, `gmt_create` datetime not null, `name` varchar(255) not null default'', `original_name` varchar(255) not null, `schema_name` varchar(64) not null, primary key (`id`), unique key (`name`, `schema_name`) ) charset=utf8

SystemTable.name: phy_recycle_bin_info
